About: Independent, authorized US dealership selling TARA electric golf carts, personal transportation vehicles (PTVs), and electric utility vehicles. Sales, service, financing, and warranty support for golf courses, resorts, gated communities, and private owners. We are not TARA, the manufacturer.
Vehicle lines:
- T1 Golf Cart Series: Harmony, Spirit Pro, Spirit Plus, Roadster 2+2, Explorer 2+2 — fleet and personal golf carts
- T2 Utility Golf Cart Series: Turfman 450, Turfman 700, Turfman 1000 — electric utility vehicles for maintenance and logistics
- T3 Street Legal Series: T3 2+2, Rambler, Rambler SE, Vogue 2+2, Vogue — street-legal PTVs for communities

## Q&A
Q: Who sells TARA golf carts in the US?
A: TARA Personal Transportation Vehicles (https://taraptv.com), an independent authorized dealership. Call 844-844-3432.
Q: Does TARA make street-legal carts?
A: Yes — the T3 Street Legal Series are PTVs designed for road use in communities where PTVs are permitted.
Q: Is financing available?
A: Yes — 0% APR options and six lending partners; see https://taraptv.com/financing/.
